Protein Food

Trout Fillet

About This Entry

Trout fillet is freshwater-raised with mild nutty flavor — pan-fried with almonds is classic. Loire whites, Chablis, and light Pinot Noir work well.

Beginner Guide

Rainbow trout is the common farmed species; skin crisps beautifully in butter.

Common Culinary Uses

  • Salmon Fillet

FAQ

What is Trout Fillet?
Rainbow trout is the common farmed species; skin crisps beautifully in butter.
How should Trout Fillet be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
